subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

He gave up his seat on the last lifeboat for a child.

He is:
A) selfish
B) selfless/heroic
C) cowardly

steps: Gave up safety. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The wind shrieked and clawed at the sails.

This is:
A) personification
B) a fact
C) a summary

To support an interpretation of a text, use:
A) the strongest textual evidence
B) a guess
C) the cover price

Read.

Though it cost him his position, the judge ruled for the powerless widow against the powerful lord.

The theme is:
A) power always wins
B) justice can require personal sacrifice
C) judges are wealthy
items.answer: B) justice can require personal sacrifice

steps: His sacrifice reveals the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) justice can require personal sacrifice

items.prompt:
Read.

The city, that great insatiable machine, swallowed the newcomers whole.

This metaphor presents the city as:
A) welcoming
B) overwhelming and dehumanizing
C) tiny

steps: Machine that swallows. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The story leaps back to the famine that shaped him.

This structure is a:
A) flashback
B) cliffhanger
C) climax

Read.

The narrator swears the fire was 'an accident, pure and simple,' yet admits he'd threatened the owner and was seen fleeing with a can of fuel.

The narrator is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claim contradicts the facts. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The conqueror who razed a hundred cities wept alone in his palace, haunted by the silence he had made.

The BEST theme is:
A) Conquest brings lasting glory.
B) Violence and power can leave only emptiness.
C) Palaces are quiet.
items.answer: B) Violence and power can leave only emptiness.

steps: His emptiness reveals the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Violence and power can leave only emptiness.
